_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.59x; +32% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.15; conservative 2yr +17%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.2%/yr (worst year FY10-FY19, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +15.6%/yr (Q4 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +18.8%/yr (FY10-FY19 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +43.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY19); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SPGI (retrospective, 2020-03-27) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.59x (65.8% downside to Bear $82 / +41.4% upside to Bull $339) | Adj composite 2.62 vs market 2.48: gap +0.15 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +32% above the EPP floor $182 (18x FY20E $10.10) | Conservative 2-yr case: +16.6% total (+8.3%/yr) | At 23.7x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $317 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Financial Services revenue +15.2% in Q4 2019, forward revenues +13% (no FY20 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2019 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
